ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a ratio of approximately 1:5 high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-contrast contiguous light-toned blobs are localized at the distal lateral margins (roughly 0.0-0.15 and 0.85-1.0 horizontal coordinate range); the central and medial lobe areas consist of uniform low-intensity dark pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the boundary; left lobe presents approximately 9 distinct peaks with variable pixel-amplitudes; right lobe presents approximately 12 peaks with higher frequency toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity observed on both lobes, curving from the submerged medial region toward the elevated lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) localized on the far-left tip (est. 12-15 units) and similar clusters on the right tip (est. 6-8 units).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacle-related circular scarring and physical encrustation concentrated on the distal lateral tips of both lobes.
